reviews.title: Amazing motherboard
reviews.comment: This motherboard is very nice, it has all the M.2 slots, fan plug ins and usb plug ins you could ask for. Unfortunately it had a couple of bent processor pins that i didnt see during assembly which caused some errors during inital start up.  I removed the motherboard and returned it and received a full refund. They even paid the shipping for the return.  I will be re-ordering it.  Sometimes these things happen.  While it was an inconvenience,  I cant blame it on Best Buy.  They're making it right.

reviews.title: I loved it
reviews.comment: This motherboard is packed with features: PCIe Gen 5 support, fast DDR5 compatibility, and rock-solid build quality. The BIOS is user-friendly, and connectivity is excellent with WiFi 7 and multiple USB ports. Perfect for overclockers and gamers looking for stability and high performance.
reviews.author: Beedo

reviews.title: Z890-E is loaded with premium features
reviews.comment:
I built a high-performance system centered around the Intel Core Ultra 9 285K and the ASUS ROG Strix Z890-E Gaming WiFi, and the experience has been fantastic in terms of stability, thermal management, and performance tuning.
It has a 20+1+2 VRM design, which easily handles the 285K's power demands even when pushing high workloads or doing light overclocking. The large VRM heatsinks keep temps under control, and the overall board layout is clean and builder-friendly. The Z890-E is an ideal match for the Ultra 9 285K. It offers excellent power delivery, thermal performance, and expandability, making it a future-proof platform for gaming, content creation, and heavy multitasking. If you're building an enthusiast-grade PC, this pairing is hard to beat.
